subject: THORChain v3.21.0 base-layer -> CosmWasm dispatch paths: authentication/authorization
key_conclusion: No public v3.21.0 dispatch path lets a fresh unprivileged external caller forge a wasm caller / execute a contract as an arbitrary address / sudo an arbitrary contract. No TxSignedBy guard exists anywhere in the wasm path.

signer_mechanism.top_level: ante SigVerificationDecorator verifies tx signature against tx.GetSigners(); for a wasm msg signers = [signer field] via cosmos.msg.v1.signer annotation
signer_mechanism.inner_dispatch: wasmd SDKMessageHandler.handleSdkMessage enforces GetMsgV1Signers(msg) subset-of {emitting contract} (handler_plugin.go:103-111)

routing.thorchain_clone: proto/thorchain/v1/types/tx.proto:56-77 clones the wasm RPCs; x/thorchain/module.go:160 registers types.MsgServer
routing.route_key: cosmos-sdk baseapp.MsgServiceRouter.registerMsgServiceHandler keys routes by sdk.MsgTypeURL(request msg) (msg_service_router.go:138,171; lookup :55)

paths.name: Top-level MsgExecuteContract
paths.auth_check: ante SigVerificationDecorator over tx.GetSigners()=[msg.Sender]; handler validate() is no-op (handler_wasm_execute_contract.go:51-53); handle reads senderAddr:=msg.Sender (:61) and calls ExecuteContract(contractAddr,senderAddr,...) (:70)
paths.fresh_unprivileged_reachable: yes, but only executes as the signer

paths.name: Contract submessage WasmMsg::Execute
paths.auth_check: EncodeWasmMsg forces Sender=emitting contract; handleSdkMessage signer check signers subset-of {contractAddr} (handler_plugin.go:103-111) passes tautologically
paths.can_execute_as_arbitrary: target arbitrary, caller fixed to emitting contract
paths.fresh_unprivileged_reachable: only as a contract that is itself the range owner (execute-as-self)
paths.notes: this is the FIN Range->Arb{then}->DoRange self-call mechanism

paths.name: Contract submessage CosmosMsg::Any/Stargate of MsgExecuteContract with foreign sender
paths.auth_check: handleSdkMessage GetMsgV1Signers(msg)=[sender]; rejects unless sender == emitting contract (handler_plugin.go:103-111)
paths.notes: classic wasmd vector; closed. Matches EXPLOIT-PATH.md section 3.4.

paths.auth_check: signer annotation authority (tx signed by msg.Authority) AND checkIsContractAdmin: caller.Equals(contractInfo.AdminAddr()) (manager_wasm_current.go:260,410-419)
paths.authority_semantics: the target contract's admin, NOT a chain-gov authority (wasmd gov policy bypassed because thorchain replaced the wasmd msg server)
paths.fresh_unprivileged_reachable: only if caller IS the target contract's admin

paths.name: Top-level MsgInstantiateContract / MsgInstantiateContract2 (runs init)
paths.auth_check: signer annotation sender; checkInstantiateAuthorization (manager_wasm_current.go:89,125,399-408) - existing contracts bypass permission

paths.name: Top-level MsgStoreCode
paths.auth_check: signer annotation sender + checkCanStore (mimir WasmPermissionless or permission list) (manager_wasm_current.go:55,353-368)

paths.name: Scheduler EndBlock ExecuteSchedule
paths.who_can_trigger: runs every block over messages scheduled via MsgScheduleExecuteContract
paths.auth_check: scheduling: signer annotation sender + (inner dispatch) sender == emitting contract; execution: Execute(execCtx, contractAddress=msg.Sender, caller=authtypes.NewModuleAddress("scheduler"), msg, coins)
paths.target_at_execution: the scheduling contract (signer-constrained to the emitter)
paths.fresh_unprivileged_reachable: can schedule, but executed contract sees info.sender == scheduler module

paths.name: Reply / error callbacks
paths.auth_check: invoked as the contract itself; reply payload has no sender field

paths.name: IBC / BeginBlock / EndBlock module hooks
paths.auth_check: no base-layer module hook dispatches wasm execution (full-repo grep: only the msg server and the scheduler call the wasm keeper)

paths.name: x/denom messages
paths.auth_check: assertContractSender requires HasContractInfo(sender) (x/denom/keeper/msg_server.go:33-45); top-level denom msgs rejected by ante default branch (x/thorchain/ante.go:264-266)

answers.a_message_type: standard wasmd cosmwasm.wasm.v1.MsgExecuteContract (signer annotation sender); THORChain registers a cloned proto service types.Msg so its own msg server handles the wasm type URLs; wasmd msg server disabled via CustomWasmModule.RegisterServices no-op
answers.b_sudo: MsgSudoContract defined at wasmd proto/cosmwasm/wasm/v1/tx.proto:314-316 (signer authority); THORChain requires msg.Authority == contractInfo.AdminAddr() (manager_wasm_current.go:260,410-419). No path for an external tx to sudo an arbitrary contract.
answers.c_internal_dispatch: Only non-message internal dispatch is the scheduler (x/scheduler/keeper/keeper.go:77); caller is the fixed scheduler module account. All other inner dispatches are constrained by wasmd signer check + encoder. No attacker-controlled sender without a signature/ante check.
answers.d_fix: In WasmExecuteContractHandler.handle (x/thorchain/handler_wasm_execute_contract.go, after parsing senderAddr ~line 61-64): if !HasContract(senderAddr) && !TxSignedBy(ctx, senderAddr) { reject }, mirroring x/thorchain/handler_send.go:123,192. The HasContract disjunct is mandatory (FIN's own self-call chain is a contract and never signs). TxSignedBy defined x/thorchain/ante.go:120-127.

fin_implication: FIN authorises Transfer on sender == range.owner where sender = info.sender of the original Range(msg). Under public v3.21.0, info.sender is always either the tx signer, the emitting contract (encoder-forced + wasmd check), or the scheduler module. No forgery path; the owner check cannot be bypassed by caller forgery. The only owner-matching caller is a contract owner executing as itself (execute-as-self, EXPLOIT-PATH.md 3.5). A TxSignedBy guard would not close that vector.
negative_results: No TxSignedBy in any wasm handler; TxSignedBy used only in x/thorchain/ante.go (def) and x/thorchain/handler_send.go:123,192
No base-layer handler constructs a wasm execute message (grep MsgExecuteContract{ / WasmMsg{ in non-test Go)
No authz/group/feegrant/circuit/gov modules in the ModuleManager (app/app.go:486-498); only custom route is cosmos.bank.v1beta1.Msg (app/app.go:446)
Scheduler caller is the fixed module account (x/scheduler/keeper/keeper.go:80)

differs_v3.21.0_vs_develop: app/app.go (unrelated: KVStoreService wiring, in-process CometBFT local client)
